findings.title: Inner Android frame contradicted the 360x800dp Foundations contract
findings.observed: 32/32 App SVGs used a 360x820 inner device frame while Foundations and tokens require 360x800.
findings.resolution: Corrected device, content, bottom-navigation and system-navigation geometry in all 32 App SVGs.

findings.title: Artifact-level cross-role disposition and evidence were missing
findings.observed: 45/45 paired records were still marked approval pending and no Phase 8 findings/evidence package existed.
findings.resolution: Added dated named AI-assisted review metadata to 45/45 records plus a findings register, validation record and five rendered evidence SVGs.

findings.title: Static Wireframes cannot execute Compose accessibility behavior
findings.observed: TalkBack order, 48dp targets, scalable text and non-color-only states are specified and visually audited, but runtime semantics, focus and 200 percent font scaling require implementation tests.

findings.title: Wireframe privacy review is not Legal approval
findings.observed: Consent, raw-audio prohibition, local deletion boundaries and Driving Mode restrictions are consistent, but provider-specific destination/retention copy requires named human Product/Legal approval before release.
